reason: An AI talking to my customers and touching my CRM and inbox, 24/7, is exactly what I'm nervous about. One line saying 'GDPR-compliant' isn't proof, and I wouldn't hand over customer data to a company I've never heard of on that basis.
objection: Where is my customer data stored, who can see it, is it used to train models, and what happens when the AI says something wrong to a client in my name? I need to approve what it sends, not find out afterwards.
would_change_my_mind: A signed DPA with EU-only hosting and no training on my data, plus a mode where nothing goes to a customer without my approval, shown to me in a demo. Then I'd try the free plan with one co-worker.
